description: Compile-time settings that change a library's ABI or that every translation unit must agree on.

abi_defines.description: Preprocessor defines whose values must be the same in every translation unit that includes the library's headers.

self_check.description: The library's own version or ABI check, called by the probe harness, or null.

min_language_standard.description: The oldest language standard the library's headers need.

exceptions.description: Whether the library throws across its API.

rtti.description: What RTTI setting the library imposes on its consumers.

consumer_flags.description: Flags that translation units using the library need, with the condition.

cxx_standard.description: The C++ standard the composition compiles with.

rules.text: Every ABI define has the same value in every translation unit that includes the library's headers, and every library's self-check passes.
rules.procedure: The CLI writes one probe source per CMake target that links the library, recording each ABI define as that target sees it; the probe harness compares the recorded values at startup and calls each library's self_check. On MSVC the same values are also emitted with #pragma detect_mismatch so a mismatch fails the link.

seeded_violation.description: Define one library's ABI define differently on one glue target.

rules.text: The composition's C++ standard is at least every library's min_language_standard; RTTI, exception and C runtime settings agree across every target the composition builds.
rules.procedure: Read from the CMake file API after configure: each target's standard, RTTI and exception flags and MSVC runtime library.

seeded_violation.description: Turn RTTI on for one glue target that links a library requiring consumers to match.
